text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- April year-on-year inflation was 1.8 percent, the lowest rate for 30 years. If the trend continues, average annual inflation will stand at between 1.5 and two percent at the end of the year.
- Grundig workers demonstrated in Braga in northern Portugal against a threat to dismiss some of them. They said they could begin a hunger strike if the company does not reconsider its decision.
- The Portuguese government will send to the European Union in Brussels a list of 31 areas that will receive priority treatment in terms of protecting the local environment.
- The office of the under-secretary for tax will propose that credit card transactions pay stamp duty.

- The domestic market could absorb 60 percent of the shares of electricity company EDP - Electricidade de Portugal in its partial priovatisation next month, a source linked to the syndicate organising the sale told the paper.
